prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Companion", "Your pet is ready for your desktop!"]
1: ["Welcome to Desktop Companions", "Bring your desktop to life with an interactive companion that lives on your screen.", "Discover a new way to interact with your workspace."]
2: ["Save Your Companion to Your Account", "Sign in now so your companion and setup preferences are safely synced to the cloud.", "Ensures your pet will never disappear when switching devices."]
3: ["Upload Pet Photos", "Upload clear, well-lit photos for the best 3D pet generation results."]
4: ["Preparing Your Pet...", "We are rendering desktop animations and configuring background controls.", "Building 3D Mesh", "Syncing Cloud Profile"]
5: ["Protect Your Desktop Pet Data", "Signing in links your pet adoption certificate securely to your email so your companion is never lost or reset.", "Already adopted a pet? Sign in with the same account to restore it instantly."]
6: ["Can't see your pet? Check your system tray menu at the bottom right corner of your screen!", "Right-click the tray icon anytime to adjust pet visibility or summon companion."]
7: ["Choose Your Starting Companion", "Select a desktop buddy to begin setup."]
8: ["You can minimize this window. We'll send a system tray notification when your pet is ready!"]
9: ["Start Your Pet Journey", "Choose how you'd like to create your companion and unlock free starter accessories!", "Bonus Unlocks: Starter Toy Set Included"]

verdicts.problem: Promotes free extras and bonus unlocks.
